title: Notice of Adverse Benefit Determination
paragraphs: We reviewed the claim submitted by Riverside Orthopedic Associates under your health plan for services provided on September 9, 2026. After review, we are unable to approve payment.

We determined that the MRI of the left knee without contrast does not meet our criteria for medical necessity under guideline OST-RAD-892. The information we received does not support the need for this service at this time. Reason code: CO-50.
The plan paid $0.00 of the $2,734.94 billed. The amount you may owe the provider is $2,734.94.

appeal.heading: Your Right to Appeal
appeal.text: You or your authorized representative may file a written appeal within 60 days of the date you receive this notice. Send it to Ostrander Mutual Health, Appeals Unit, PO Box 85186, Sacramento, CA 95814. If waiting for a standard decision could seriously harm your health, you may ask for an expedited appeal by calling 1-800-555-9509.
appeal.external: After the internal appeal, you may have the right to an independent external review. Free help is available from your state's consumer assistance program.
